deviations.claim_in_article: “Oil prices did not fall across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn”; the title and closing summary also broadly say that oil prices stayed high.
deviations.issue: The Ledger reports the short-term movement of Brent futures, but the article generalizes that observation to oil prices across the whole market.
deviations.explanation: The broad whole-market claim is not established by the Brent-specific observation in HF-009. This is a scope expansion and an unsupported factual claim; the Japanese source already makes the same generalization.
deviations.qualifier_text: Nearby: “Brent crude oil futures briefly lost some of their gains.” This qualifies the Brent movement, but not the claim about the whole market.
